content.user_title: Design Apple Experiences with HIG Patterns
content.value_statement: Apple interaction decisions can become inconsistent across flows and platforms. This skill recommends HIG-aligned patterns, implementation steps, platform variations, and common pitfalls.
actual_capabilities: Recommends an Apple HIG interaction pattern for a stated user goal.
Explains the rationale and cites the relevant bundled reference topic.
Creates step-by-step guidance for screens, states, feedback, and recovery.
Describes variations across iOS, iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, watchOS, and visionOS.
Reviews flows for modality, loading, onboarding, permissions, undo, and interruptions.
Identifies common pattern mistakes that conflict with Apple guidance.
limitations: Provides design guidance but does not implement interfaces or run usability tests.
Bundled references may not include later changes to Apple guidelines.
Needs the target platform, user goal, and surrounding flow for specific recommendations.
Does not replace accessibility, privacy, security, or App Review validation.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Interaction
use_cases.description: Select suitable patterns and define screens, states, feedback, and recovery before visual design begins.

use_cases.title: Prepare an Implementation
use_cases.description: Translate a feature flow into platform-aware interaction requirements and edge cases for engineering.

use_cases.title: Review an Existing Flow
use_cases.description: Compare onboarding, settings, media, or account flows with HIG guidance and prioritize corrections.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Pattern
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend an Apple HIG pattern for [user goal] on [platform]. Explain the rationale and list the core screens or states.

prompt_templates.title: Improve a Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this [flow] for [platform]: [description]. Identify HIG issues and recommend changes for feedback, loading, recovery, and user control.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt Across Platforms
prompt_templates.prompt: Adapt [interaction] for [Apple platforms]. Detail differences in modality, input, layout, interruptions, and system behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Write an Interaction Specification
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an implementation-ready interaction specification for [feature] across [platforms]. Include state transitions, edge cases, permissions, undo, accessibility considerations, and reference topics.

output_examples.input: Recommend an onboarding pattern for an iPhone budgeting app that needs notification permission.
output_examples.output: Start with the primary budgeting task and defer permission requests. Ask for notifications when alerts become relevant, explain the value, and provide a skip path.

output_examples.input: Review a permanent delete action that uses a confirmation alert.
output_examples.output: Prefer immediate deletion with a visible undo action when recovery is feasible. Keep confirmation for irreversible loss, then state the consequence and destructive action clearly.

output_examples.input: Adapt a video playback flow for tvOS and visionOS.
output_examples.output: Use familiar playback controls and preserve continuity on tvOS. In visionOS, let people enter immersion and keep transport controls visible and unobstructed.

best_practices: Provide the target platform, user goal, preceding state, and following state.
Describe destructive actions, permissions, payments, and other sensitive moments explicitly.
Validate recommendations against current Apple documentation and test them with representative users.
anti_patterns: Do not request generic HIG advice without describing the feature or workflow.
Do not apply one platform interaction unchanged across every Apple device.
Do not treat guideline recommendations as proof of accessibility or App Review approval.

faq.question: Which platforms does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers interaction guidance for iOS, iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, watchOS, and visionOS.

faq.question: Can it review an existing product flow?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the current screens, states, platform, user goal, and known constraints.

faq.question: Does it generate production code?
faq.answer: No. It produces interaction recommendations and implementation guidance, not production interface code.

faq.question: Does it cite relevant guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. The requested output format cites the relevant bundled reference topic.

faq.question: Is its guidance guaranteed to be current?
faq.answer: No. Confirm important decisions against the latest Apple Human Interface Guidelines and platform documentation.

faq.question: What information produces the best result?
faq.answer: Provide the target platforms, user goal, surrounding flow, sensitive actions, constraints, and whether the work is new or existing.
